craft.heading: Crazy horse leather, stitched by hand
craft.body: Every piece is cut from full hides by local artisans. The waxed surface marks and darkens with use, so no two pieces age the same way.

steps.title: The material
steps.body: We buy whole hides and reject about a third. What is left is graded by hand for grain, thickness and stretch.

steps.title: The cutting
steps.body: Straps are cut along the spine where the hide is tightest, so a belt holds its shape instead of curling.

steps.title: The stitching
steps.body: One row of saddle stitch, two needles, waxed linen thread. It cannot unravel the way a machine seam can.

steps.title: The finish
steps.body: Edges bevelled, sanded, burnished four times, sealed with beeswax. Then the buckle goes on and it is checked.

craft.flag: The brief asks for leather selection → cutting → stitching → edge finishing imagery. No photographs of the workshop or of these stages exist in the repo; only finished-product photos. Step imagery will have to use product macro shots unless you supply workshop photos.

about.headline: We cut leather, not corners
about.intro: We cut in Pakistan, from hides we choose ourselves. One workshop, a small bench, no subcontracting.

sections.title: The name
sections.body: Stagr takes its name from the stag. An antler is a record of the years behind it, thickened and scarred and branched, and none of it is covered up. We ask the same of leather. It should show its age rather than hide it.

sections.title: The workshop
sections.body: We cut in Pakistan, from hides we choose ourselves. One workshop, a small bench, no subcontracting. A belt leaves us when it is right, not when the week ends.

sections.title: The price
sections.body: Prices run from Rs 1,740 to Rs 3,500. That is the whole range, and it is the same for a gift of one or an order of a hundred.

values.title: One workshop
values.body: Nothing is subcontracted. If something is wrong, the person who made it fixes it.

values.title: One price
values.body: The same rate for a single gift or an order of a hundred, minus the volume tier.

values.title: No filler
values.body: No bonded leather, no split hide, no plated buckles dressed up as brass.

values.title: Repairs
values.body: Bring it back at any age. We re-stitch and re-burnish for the cost of the thread.

about.quote: A belt should outlast the suit it was bought for. Everything we do follows from that.

seoCopy.title: Handmade Crazy Horse Leather Wallets – Timeless Quality for Men
paragraphs: Welcome to Stagr, where premium craftsmanship meets rugged elegance. We specialize in crafting handmade wallets using high-grade crazy horse leather — known for its distinctive vintage look and unmatched durability. Our collection includes classic bifold wallets, sleek minimalist wallets, spacious long wallets, and practical leather card holders, all tailored for men who appreciate quality and style.

Explore Our Signature Leather Wallets Collection: Each wallet at Stagr is carefully handcrafted by local artisans using 100% genuine crazy horse leather. Whether you prefer the compact design of a minimalist wallet or the full functionality of a bifold or long wallet, we have a leather accessory designed to fit your needs. Our card holders are perfect for those seeking a lightweight yet stylish option.

Thoughtful Gifts, Crafted with Purpose: Looking for a meaningful gift? Our leather wallets for men make a perfect choice. Each product is elegantly packaged and ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, corporate giveaways, and festive gifting. We also offer corporate gift preparation for businesses looking to deliver premium value to clients or teams — explore our gifting page for tailored solutions.
whyChoose: 100% crazy horse leather – durable, stylish, and full of character
Locally handcrafted with precision and pride
Range of styles: bifold, trifold, long, card holders, and minimalist wallets

Elegant gift-ready packaging for all orders
seoCopy.closing: Join hundreds of satisfied customers who trust Stagr for their everyday wallets and special gifts. We are proud to deliver quality and heritage through every piece we craft.

faqs.q: What type of leather is used in your products?
faqs.a: Every Stagr piece is made from 100% pure crazy horse leather: full grain cowhide treated with wax, which gives it its rugged look and a patina that deepens with use.

faqs.q: Do you offer corporate gifting services?
faqs.a: Yes. We prepare boxed corporate gifts and bulk orders for teams and clients. Visit the Gifting page or message us on WhatsApp to get started.

faqs.q: How do you ensure product quality?
faqs.a: Each wallet and belt is cut and stitched by hand by our artisans and checked before it is packed and sent.
Yes. Many pieces can be personalised with monograms or embossing. Message us on WhatsApp with what you have in mind.

faqs.q: How should I care for my leather product?
faqs.a: Keep it dry and away from direct heat. Wipe it with a soft cloth, and condition it now and then. Scuffs on crazy horse leather can often be rubbed out with your thumb.

faqs.q: Are your products available in stores?
faqs.a: Stagr is sold online at stagr.pk, with delivery across Pakistan in 3 to 5 working days.

faqs.q: What is your return or exchange policy?
faqs.a: Details are on our Returns & Refunds page. For help with an order, contact us on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: How can I stay updated on your new arrivals and deals?
faqs.a: Join our newsletter at the bottom of the page and follow @stagr.pk on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.

care.short: Keep it dry and away from direct heat. Wipe it with a soft cloth, and condition it now and then. Scuffs on crazy horse leather can often be rubbed out with your thumb.
care.accordion: Wipe with a dry cloth. Condition twice a year. Keep it rolled, not folded, and let it dry away from heat if it gets wet.
